verdict: Clients are not receiving software updates because no SUP is reachable through their boundary group. Starting in MECM 1702, clients select SUPs the same way they select DPs -- via boundary group membership.
fix: In the console, add the SUP to the client's boundary group (`Administration -> Hierarchy Configuration -> Boundary Groups -> <group> -> References -> Add`). Multiple SUPs per boundary group are supported; clients load-balance across them. For a quick emergency workaround, enable `Fallback` on the boundary group to let clients reach a SUP in a neighboring group.
